iqr.review: Very much...I did both together...under IQR...It was easy...and both the courses are related so some lectures gonna be similar...which actually helped me to clear the concepts..
Take it under iqr sir's supervision...
Na. 413 er kono pre requisite nai. You can take without 411. For further confusion, you can contact IqR sir. He mostly doesn't reply to mails. So preferably, office time e giye kotha bolte hobe

You will learn from sir, both theoretical and practical stuff, get good grades. And he will give you loads of assignments, which are very beneficial for you and those will help you in quizzes, midterm and, also in finals.

Eee363 is the most hardest as well as important course for EEE background ..
you need to be serious about this course..most of the questions in Job interview will be from there...
In the other hand EEE411 is moderate course but IQR gives huge pressure with assignment ..you have to make at least 16-19 assignment out of 22 classes...
My suggestion will be not taking 3 courses ..takes 221 and 411 or 363+221...
BTW if your concept is not cleared in 221 big blunder is coming in 342 and 321...
You will not get a single word for both courses..
